# kernels.percentiles_1d { #imcombiners.kernels.percentiles_1d }

```python
kernels.percentiles_1d(values, q, *, validate=True)
```

Return NaN-aware percentiles of a 1-D value vector.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**values**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [(ndarray, shape(N,))]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Input vector. Accepted dtypes are `uint8`, `uint16`, `int16`, `int32`, `float32`, and `float64`. Integer inputs are promoted to the package's floating workspace when `validate` is `True`.

<code>[**q**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [scalar or 1-D array-like]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Percentile position or positions in `[0, 100]`. Interpolation matches NumPy's default linear method. `NaN` values in `values` are ignored.

<code>[**validate**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [True]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   If `True`, check dimensionality and normalize dtype/contiguity before entering the Rust kernel. If `False`, callers must provide a contiguous `float32` or `float64` vector.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[**percentiles**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [scalar or ndarray]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If `q` is scalar, returns a scalar. If `q` is 1-D, returns shape `(len(q),)`. All-NaN vectors return `NaN`.
